newsitem.title: JAPAN: G7 to discuss forex rates at Berlin meeting -- BOJ.
newsitem.headline: G7 to discuss forex rates at Berlin meeting -- BOJ.

text.p: The Group of Seven (G7) industrial nations will discuss exchange rates and economic conditions of each member nation at their meeting on Saturday in Berlin, Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita told a news conference on Thursday.
He said he was not aware of what specific issues would be focused on at the G7 meeting.
The central bank governors and finance ministers of the G7 countries will attend the meeting, including Matsushita and Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka.
Matsushita said he did not have anything to say about the G7 meeting, as there was no set scenario ahead of the meeting, and participants would freely discuss any topics.
As in the past, currencies and economic issues were likely to be discussed, he said.
